name: Cook Counseling Center
description: Explore counseling support and connect with the Cook team to discuss next steps.
access: Call 540-231-6557 during weekday business hours to schedule. Complete the paperwork sent before your appointment.
constraints: Psychiatry requires a treatment-provider referral and concurrent counseling. Individual Cook therapy cannot run concurrently with TimelyCare scheduled therapy.

name: TimelyCare scheduled counseling
description: Up to 12 virtual counseling appointments per academic year, with evening and weekend scheduling options published by VT.
access: Follow VT's TimelyCare page to connect and choose a provider and appointment time.
constraints: Cannot be used concurrently with individual therapy at Cook Counseling. Published scheduling options are not a live availability feed.

name: TimelyCare TalkNow
tagline: Someone to talk to, day or night
description: VT describes TalkNow as unlimited, on-demand emotional support available 24/7, either alongside therapy or on its own.
access: Open VT's TimelyCare page and follow the connection instructions for TalkNow.
constraints: TalkNow is distinct from scheduled counseling. This directory does not provide emergency response or clinical assessment.

name: Schiffert Health Center
description: Find appointment instructions for the Medical, Gynecology, and Allergy & Immunization clinics.
access: Use the Healthy Hokies Portal linked on the official page, or call 540-231-6444.
constraints: Appointments cannot be requested by email. Confirm eligibility and current times with Schiffert. For a medical emergency, call 911.
audience: Virginia Tech students; confirm eligibility with the center

name: Hokie Wellness
tagline: Build everyday habits that support you
description: Explore university well-being programs and resources through Hokie Wellness.
access: Visit Hokie Wellness and choose the student resources or programs relevant to you.
constraints: Programs, formats, and eligibility vary. Educational well-being resources are not a medical appointment service.
audience: Virginia Tech community; program eligibility varies

name: Services for Students with Disabilities
description: Connect with SSD about individualized accommodations, access, resources, and academic support.
access: Use the official site's connection instructions to begin the interactive accommodations process.
constraints: Accommodations are determined with SSD based on individual needs. Listing a resource does not establish approval or eligibility.
